_about: Third-party material no package manager knows about. Read by scripts/notices.mjs and shown on docs/guide/code-use.md and in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Each entry was checked against the repository on 2026-11-20; add an entry in the same change that introduces the material, and remove it in the change that removes it. 'use' is one of: container image, separate process, font files, copied source, linked library.

entries.name: Node.js (official Docker image node)
entries.license: MIT (Node.js; its LICENSE also lists bundled libraries under their own licences); image build files MIT (nodejs/docker-node); the image also contains Debian bookworm packages under their own licences
entries.licenseEvidence: Node.js LICENSE (https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/LICENSE, and the same file in a Node 22 install) opens 'Node.js is licensed for use as follows:' followed by the MIT text and a list of externally maintained libraries; nodejs/docker-node LICENSE is MIT, 'Copyright (c) 2015 Joyent, Inc.'
entries.notes: Build and run stages of the web app image.

entries.name: Python (official Docker image python)
entries.license: PSF-2.0 (Python); image build files unverified; the image also contains Debian packages under their own licences
entries.licenseEvidence: Python's LICENSE.txt (in a Python 3.13 install) contains 'PYTHON SOFTWARE FOUNDATION LICENSE VERSION 2'; the image's Docker Hub page points to that licence information for Python 3 and states the image contains other software under other licences. The licence of the docker-library/python build files could not be read (GitHub rate limit) and is unverified.
entries.notes: Base image of the planner service.

entries.name: pgvector (Docker image pgvector/pgvector)
entries.licenseEvidence: pgvector LICENSE (https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector/blob/master/LICENSE): 'Portions Copyright (c) 1996-2026, PostgreSQL Global Development Group ... Permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute this software and its documentation for any purpose, without fee, and without a written agreement is hereby granted', the PostgreSQL Licence text. pgvector's Dockerfile builds FROM postgres:$PG_MAJOR-$DEBIAN_CODENAME, so the image also contains the PostgreSQL entry below and Debian trixie packages under their own licences.
entries.notes: The db service. The extension is loaded by the database server; the web app talks to it over the network.

entries.name: schematic-symbols drawings
entries.licenseEvidence: node_modules/schematic-symbols/LICENSE (0.0.251): 'MIT License. Copyright (c) 2024 tscircuit'. The package is also a dev dependency, listed with the npm packages.
entries.origin: the symbol drawings (lines, circles and pin points only) of resistor_right, capacitor_polarized_right, diode_right, led_right, spst_switch_right, push_button_normally_open_momentary_horz, battery_horz, speaker_right, ground_down and vcc_up, copied by scripts/extract-symbols.mjs from schematic-symbols 0.0.251 (https://github.com/tscircuit/schematic-symbols). Each one's history was read in the repository on 21 November 2026: resistor added in 419e439 (#272, Inkscape SVG); capacitor_polarized in d89e83a (#212) and refined in #384; diode and led split in 8c4f2af from the combined Inkscape symbols.svg first committed in 85f3d35 by the package's author; spst_switch in 9962748 (#254); push_button_normally_open_momentary in 495c76e; battery in 4a4c906 (#174); speaker in 8c4e6fc (#444, hand-written SVG by the package's author); ground in e130627; vcc reworked in 7a0855e. None of these commits or files names KiCad or another symbol set as a source; most SVGs carry an Inkscape mark. That is evidence they were drawn by contributors, not proof. Not used: the package's capacitor and boxresistor, whose dimensions were matched to KiCad's Device:C and Device:R in 993737d (#434) and 2592db4 (#435); the capacitor and motor symbols are this project's own drawings instead.
entries.changes: Coordinates rounded to four decimals; text placeholders dropped; orientation fixed to the listed variant. Scaled and placed on a 2.54 mm grid at run time by src/lib/parts/symbols.ts.
entries.notes: Only drawings are used. tscircuit's layout engine, renderer and viewer are not used (docs/trials/tscircuit). No symbol from KiCad's library is bundled; the KiCad export embeds these drawings and boxes drawn by src/lib/parts/symbols.ts.

entries.name: KiCad command-line tool (kicad-cli), CI only
entries.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (KiCad); its libraries are not installed or used
entries.licenseEvidence: https://www.kicad.org/about/licenses/ states KiCad's source code is licensed under the GNU GPL version 3 or later; not re-read in full for this entry.
entries.notes: Installed in CI only, run as its own program to load the exported .kicad_sch (sch export netlist, sch erc). Not part of the app or its image. Installed without recommended packages, so KiCad's symbol libraries are not installed.
